Very disappointing and unprofessional experience with Earth Banquets.

They did not clearly disclose the full terms and conditions at the time of booking. A representative named Mansi Gawde collected ₹59,000 (including 18% GST) from us without informing us that the amount was non-refundable.

When we later questioned this, we were told that if another booking happened for the same date (19 April 2026, from 5 PM onwards), the amount would be refunded. Acting in good faith, we patiently waited and followed up.

featured_reviews.name: vaibhav kulkarni
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently booked Grande C Banquets at Nesco in Goregaon East, Mumbai for a family wedding, and here's my take:

The sheer size of the banquet space is impressive. The ceiling height can accommodate even the most extravagant events, adding a touch of grandeur to any occasion. The venue is divided into three massive sections, A, B, and C, each capable of hosting between 350-400 guests. What's even better is that these sections can be combined for larger gatherings, providing great flexibility.

While Grande C is undeniably one of the pricier options (at approximately 2k per head), I was pleasantly surprised to find room for negotiation, even during peak season. The venue provides the space and caters the food. However, the catch lies in the decor. I found the decor costs to be higher than what I expected, and the empaneled decorators didn't always grasp our vision as well as we'd hoped.

It's worth noting that there's a BMC parking charge of 15,000, which should be taken into consideration.

In terms of staff, I must say the Nesco team was exceptional. Their attentiveness and professionalism contributed significantly to our positive experience. I would rate them a solid 10/10.

On the other hand, while the venue itself is outstanding, the decor aspect brings the overall experience down a notch. I'd rate it a 6/10.

In average, I'd give my experience at Grande C Banquets a 7/10. With careful consideration of the decor aspect, it proves to be an excellent choice for hosting sizable events.
